scope: Offline fixed-duration queue sensitivity; not E2B capacity or RL speedup
duration_proxy: episode_s - create_wait_and_api_s: removes combined historical create queue + API interval
arrival_assumption: All 256 jobs available at time zero; FIFO, work-conserving identical logical slots
resampling: 32 task groups sampled with replacement; preserves the eight samples within each group
uncertainty: 5th/95th empirical bootstrap percentiles conditional on these 32 groups and fixed service proxies, not a confidence interval for real throughput
limitations: No model-serving, GPU, CPU, network or sandbox resource feedback; durations are assumed invariant under concurrency.
Historical durations already reflect workload/model contention at their original setting; that contention is not rescaled.
SDK create service time is omitted with its inseparable historical queue time; readiness/setup and other remaining phases stay in the fixed duration proxy.
No learner updates, weight synchronization, checkpointing, policy change or batch dependencies are simulated.
The two historical 128-rollout cohorts are combined into one hypothetical 256-job arrival; no measured 256-concurrency point is claimed.
